title: 示例 · Blue Pill 按键 + 内部上拉
summary: 按键一端接 GPIO、一端接 GND，GPIO 设为“输入 + 内部上拉”：松开读 1，按下读 0。
description:
STM32 Blue Pill 的任意一个 GPIO 接按键的一端，按键另一端接 GND。引脚设成 **输入 + 内部上拉**（约 40 kΩ 接到 3.3 V）：
- 松开：上拉把引脚拉到 3.3 V，读到 **1**；
- 按下：引脚直接接地，读到 **0**，上拉电阻里流过 3.3 V / 40 kΩ ≈ 82 µA。

如果只设成“输入（浮空）”，松开时引脚什么都没接，读数是不确定的。

en.title: Example · Blue Pill button + internal pull-up
en.summary: A button from a GPIO to GND, with the GPIO set to input + pull-up: released reads 1, pressed reads 0.
en.description:
Wire one side of a button to any STM32 Blue Pill GPIO and the other side to GND. Set the pin to **input + pull-up** (about 40 kΩ to 3.3 V):
- released: the pull-up holds the pin at 3.3 V and it reads **1**;
- pressed: the pin is tied to GND and reads **0**, with 3.3 V / 40 kΩ ≈ 82 µA through the pull-up.

As a plain (floating) input the pin is connected to nothing while the button is released, so the reading is undefined.
hints: Button between the GPIO and GND — no resistor needed.
Set the pin to input + pull-up.
tests: Pressed: reads LOW, ≈ 82 µA through the pull-up
